character_generator.note: Target for the character reference generator. Checked against a live instance on 2026-10-18: every role is installed, so the graph can be built and measured now. The repository on Hugging Face is access-gated, so downloads of anything else need an authenticated client.

roles.note: Quantisation variants of two checkpoints, base and step-distilled. One is enough. Grouped as alternatives on purpose: listing them flat made the checker report five files as missing when none were.

FLUX 3 ships its own upsampler and the graph uses it in box mode: it re-plans the layout, then Flux3BoxReconcileKJ puts our ids back on the boxes. This is the refine step -- nothing needs to be invented for it.

Reading the reference images is what turns multi-reference into a character sheet. Assumed missing at first because a name filter looked for 'flux' or 'klein'; the checker found it by asking the machine instead.
Shared with the FLUX 2 path; already there for the first-frame editor.

character_generator.graph_note: The character sheet comes from Flux3PromptBuilderKJ: draw boxes on the output canvas, give each an id and a description, cite the id in the prompt, and it appends the boxes as a JSON table on a 0-1000 grid. Its references input grows with the number of references, so the count is not fixed. No latent trick is needed, unlike the FLUX 2 path, which required the enhancer pack to inject reference latents.
character_generator.upstream_workflows_note: Listed from the repository's file browser, which answers even on a gated repository. Their contents have not been read: an unauthenticated fetch returns the restriction notice instead of the file.
why_this_model: multi-reference generation is native: it takes several references and keeps characters recognisable across inputs, which is the character-sheet gesture
5.6B parameters, so a reference costs seconds rather than minutes
the same model does text-to-image, single-reference edit and multi-reference composition, so one graph covers the three things the character page needs
the layout builder that ships with it is a visual box editor, which is the interaction the character page wants anyway
